intro: No hot water at your villa? Whether it is an electric unit tripping the breaker or a rooftop solar system running lukewarm, I handle water heater repair & installation Seminyak-wide. With many homes here sitting 15–25 years old and high rental occupancy pushing daily demand, heaters wear out fast and need sorting between check-ins.

sections.text: Villas in Petitenget were often built two decades ago with pipework and internal components that have simply reached end-of-life. Dense plots mean pump rooms are cramped behind shared walls, so a slow flange leak can reach a neighbour's ceiling before anyone notices. Monsoon rains flood lanes and stress drainage, pulling moisture into electrical connections over time. I diagnose whether the fault is a burnt element, stuck thermostat, corroded anode, or failing gas valve — then repair or replace on site.

In busy rental streets like Basangkasa, hot-water complaints land right between guest departure and arrival. A heater tripping the main breaker at seven in the morning, a steady drip from a tank joint, or a solar array delivering only tepid water all need resolving quickly so the next stay starts smoothly. I carry common replacement elements, thermostats, and gaskets for electric and gas units, and I install new heaters where the old one has finally given up entirely.

sections.h3: What to Send Me on WhatsApp
sections.text: Before I can quote, send a few clear photos of the unit (brand plate if visible), the breaker panel showing which trip has reset, and any visible leaks or error lights. Tell me whether it is an electric tank, gas cylinder heater, or rooftop solar setup, and roughly how long it has been acting up. Pricing depends entirely on the job — parts access, height, pipework condition — so I confirm after seeing your photos. Just message me on WhatsApp with what you have.

Salt-air humidity accelerates corrosion inside tanks, so swapping the sacrificial anode every couple of years saves the whole unit. After the wet season, check that lane flooding has not seeped into your pump room and corroded terminal blocks. Avoid running the heater at maximum setting continuously; a thermostat set a few degrees lower extends element life noticeably. If morning pressure drops across the street, flag the shared-pipe issue before it stresses your internal valve further.

faq.q: How quickly can you fix a heater between guest stays?
faq.a: It depends on the fault and whether a specific part needs sourcing — send photos on WhatsApp and I will tell you exactly what is needed and when I can be there.

faq.q: Can you install a new heater where the old one was removed?
faq.a: Yes, I handle full installations including pipework adjustments for electric, gas, or solar units, working around the tight spaces typical in older Seminyak villas.

faq.q: Do you cover villas outside central Seminyak like Batu Belig?
faq.a: My work area includes Petitenget, Basangkasa, and Batu Belig among others — message me on WhatsApp with your address and I will confirm coverage.
